description_en: Queries statistics on sites and API operations that involve personal information
description_zh: 查询个人信息涉及站点及接口统计
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-sensitive-api-statistic --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSensitiveApiStatistic

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The domain name or IP address to which the API operation belongs
parameters.name: matched_host

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in seconds.
Compliance review currently supports querying data only for the last 1 month, last 3 months, last 6 months, last 12 months, or from January 1 of the previous year to the present. Make sure the time range is valid
parameters.help_zh:
查询的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
合规审查当前仅支持查询最近1个月、最近3个月、最近6个月、最近12个月、自去年1月1日至今的数据，请确保时间的合法性
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in seconds.

Compliance review currently supports querying data only for the last 1 month, last 3 months, last 6 months, last 12 months, or from January 1 of the previous year to the present. Make sure the time range is valid
parameters.help_zh:
查询的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。

合规审查当前仅支持查询最近1个月、最近3个月、最近6个月、最近12个月、自去年1月1日至今的数据，请确保时间的合法性
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number to return in a paged query. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10, which indicates 10 entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为10，表示每页包含10条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
只针对混合云场景，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html获取混合云集群信息
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The dimension for statistics. Valid values:

matchedHost (default): statistics by domain name.

apiFormat: statistics by API operation.

When the apiFormat dimension is used, specify the corresponding domain name in the MatchedHost parameter
parameters.help_zh:
统计的维度。取值：

matchedHost（默认）：表示域名维度的统计。

apiFormat：表示API维度的统计。

apiFormat 维度统计，需要指定对应的域名入参MatchedHost
parameters.name: type

InfoOutboundCount.description_en: The number of outbound personal information entries at the domain name level
InfoOutboundCount.description_zh: 域名维度的出境个人信息条数

List.description_en:
The list of API operation statistics information under the domain name.

This field is returned only when the Type parameter is set to apiFormat, which represents the API dimension statistics information
List.description_zh:
域名下的API接口统计列表。

需要入参 Type 为 apiFormat 时，才返回API维度的统计信息

items.description_en: The API operation statistics information under the domain name
items.description_zh: 域名下的API接口统计信息

ApiId.description_en: The ID of the API operation

InfoCount.description_en: The number of outbound personal information entries at the API level
InfoCount.description_zh: API维度的出境个人信息条数

SensitiveCode.description_en: The list of sensitive data types

SensitiveCount.description_en: The number of outbound sensitive personal information items at the API level
SensitiveCount.description_zh: API维度的出境个人敏感信息数量

MatchedHost.description_en: The domain name or IP address

SensitiveOutboundCount.description_en: The number of outbound sensitive personal information items at the domain name level
SensitiveOutboundCount.description_zh: 域名维度的出境个人敏感信息数量

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
